continuity.notes: Revised landscape pass: portray Guruvayurappan with one stable murti identity derived from the D001 idol reference and approved character sheet. Keep the same youthful face, frontal calm, crown silhouette, jewelry arrangement, yellow dhoti, red-orange shawl, and deep blue mural skin whenever the Lord appears. Let each stanza's symbolism change the setting and composition, not the deity identity. Use full-bleed matte temple-mural rendering throughout. Portraits remain paused.

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use intake/D001/001.jpg as the primary guide to the Guruvayur murti's frontal stance, face proportions, crown silhouette, and arrangement of ornaments. Use the approved character sheet for the established deep-blue skin, youthful expression, peacock-feather crown, yellow dhoti, red-orange shawl, and mural identity. Translate both into the flat matte series style; do not copy either reference's framing or glossy surface treatment.

must_show: The full standing Guruvayurappan murti, frontal and serene in the sanctum, with the D001 reference's distinctive face proportions, crown silhouette, layered adornment, and composed stance; retain the established blue deity skin, yellow dhoti, red-orange shawl, and peacock feather
A warm ochre-gold sanctum arch and traditional oil lamps, with a boundless calm field of bliss and consciousness opening subtly beyond the shrine
The sense that time and space do not limit Brahman, shown with fading celestial cycles and dissolving horizon boundaries, without clocks, coordinates, or text
Scriptural wisdom suggested only by small abstract palm-leaf forms in the architecture, without legible marks
scene_brief.composition: Full-bleed landscape; centered full-length murti under an arch, with cosmic depth held behind the sanctum; safe space around crown, hands, and feet; no outer frame
scene_brief.tone: awe + reverence; fortunate devotees implied (small silhouettes with folded hands)
